mdi_hd2020.name: Análisis Estadístico: Homicidio Doloso en Paraguay (realizado en 2021 con datos hasta 2020)
mdi_hd2020.publisher: Ministerio del Interior, Dirección del Observatorio de Seguridad y Convivencia Ciudadana (DOSCC); underlying data: Departamento de Estadísticas de la Policía Nacional and Dirección General de Prevención y Seguridad de la Policía Nacional; population: INE projections (revisión 2015)
mdi_hd2020.years: Victim counts 2018-2020; rates 2015-2020; multiple-homicide cases 2016-2020; multiple-homicide detail 2019 and 2020
mdi_hd2020.notes: Extracted with pdftotext -layout. Victim counts by department sum exactly to the printed national totals (497, 554, 481); 2019 appears in both count tables and matches. Rates are as printed (decimal comma converted to point); the national rate appears twice in the rate table (2 decimals and 1 decimal) and both rows are kept. Rates marked (*) in the source for Alto Paraguay, Ñeembucú and Boquerón carry no footnote text in the PDF. Multiple-homicide tables (cases, and for 2019 cases and victims by type) sum to their printed totals. In the 2020 multiple-homicide table the source writes "Capital" for the row matched here to Asunción. National-only tables in the report (by month, by weapon and sex, by age and sex, 2008-2020 national series) are not included because they have no area breakdown; they are in raw/hd2020.pdf.

b: Total (rounded to one decimal, as printed in second row)
